Finite diagnostics are supporting evidence, not infinity proofs.

value.rationale: Length 2k is the natural, sharp coding length for complete scattered-subsequence coverage. A single forbidden contiguous factor is a standard strictly local channel constraint. Classifying all sixteen length-four patterns is a complete naturally motivated family, and this is the first short forbidden-factor case in which five genuinely different growth regimes emerge, including algebraic constants distinct from two and the golden ratio. Exact infinite rational laws, a symmetry classification and a sharp feasibility statement provide structural information beyond any isolated finite census.
